Meditate periodically with Agesta’s Sacred Codes techniques to sharpen your skills, promote healing, and accelerate your progress.

Experience the transformative power of “Inner Cleanse” Meditation by using Agesta’s sacred codes to bring positive shifts into your life. For best results, practice this meditation consistently over 9, 15, or 21 days.

Sacred codes are numerical sequences believed to help individuals connect with higher vibrational energies, manifest their intentions, and encourage holistic healing. Introduced by channellers like Jose Gabriel Uribe (Agesta), these numbers are said to originate from beings of light and serve as a spiritual technology to elevate human consciousness.

To activate a sacred code, simply repeat the numerical sequence—either silently or aloud—while in a meditative state. Many practitioners report beneficial experiences with these techniques. Whether used for manifestation, healing, or spiritual growth, these numerical sequences remain a fascinating tool in modern esoteric practices.

Benefits and Sacred Codes:

  • Aura sealing and protection (Code: 19 91 91 3)
  • Transmutation of blockages (Code: 86 0 9 0 7)
  • Increased self-love and self-confidence (Code: 8 7 7)
  • Liberation from karmic bonds (Code: 44 33 55)
  • Resolution of pending matters (Code: 7 9 1)
  • Removal of implants (Code: 16 79)
  • Release from karmic contracts (Code: 11 18)
  • Healing of the genealogical tree (Code: 5 53)
  • Elimination of negative hereditary factors (Code: 31 4)
  • Healing of painful memories from the womb (Code: 52)
  • Healing of overwhelming memories from 9 months to 7 years (Code: 91 9)
  • Healing of painful memories from 7 years to 18 years (Code: 59)
  • Erasure of negative memories from the subconscious (Code: 45 60 0)
  • Dissolution of remnants of black magic (Code: 44)
  • Cutting telepathic ties hindering progress (Code: 5 77)
  • Reconciliation with the inner child and acknowledgement of its virtues (Code: 34 4)
  • Detachment from negative relationships and attraction of positive ones (Code: 7 25)
  • Cleansing and removal of negative energies and entities (Code: 0 9 27)
  • Removal of interferences from the lower astral (Code: 23 7)
  • Cultivation of gratitude in all aspects of life (Code: 33 33)
